# e2e coverage ledger — generated by framework-verify-server-e2e.sh --write-ledger

# Each 'uncovered:' line is a DECLARED gap: a surface that has no end-to-end test yet.
# The gate treats this as a ratchet — a surface may move uncovered -> covered (delete its
# line), but a NEW surface may not be born uncovered, and a covered one may not regress.
#
# Deleting a line without writing the test makes the gate fail, which is the point:
# the backlog is visible and burns down deliberately instead of being quietly forgotten.
